en.headline: Tse says five-year plan avoids rigid targets to ease planned-economy fears
en.dek: The constitutional affairs chief told Sing Tao that only five of 22 indicators are binding, and that the annual policy address is the moment for a small review.
body: Secretary for Constitutional and Mainland Affairs Janice Tse said Hong Kong kept most targets in its first five-year plan from being drawn too tightly, so the document would not be read as a move towards a planned economy.

In an interview published by Sing Tao on Monday morning, Tse said the plan, released last month, lists 22 main indicators, of which only five are binding. She said targets that are set too rigidly invite the criticism of a planned economy, while targets that are not set at all invite the criticism of a lack of accountability. Gross domestic product is hard to forecast because it covers every sector, she said, but the government still wants growth to stay within a reasonable range, and would have to explain a result that lagged a global pace of about 3 to 4 per cent.

Tse said the government would keep monitoring progress, managing risks and assessing delivery. She described the annual policy address as the right moment for a small stocktake of what had gone well and what should be sped up, and said a plan should not be rewritten often if the overall direction is sound, or markets and investors would lose confidence.

She also said Hong Kong has not decided whether to bring in a third-party review of the kind Macau is exploring. Public comment, the media and professional groups already scrutinise the plan, she said. The consultation that she coordinated after taking up the post at the end of March drew more than 17,000 submissions, with more than 80 per cent from individuals.

zh.headline: 謝小華：五年規劃不設過死指標 免被指計劃經濟
zh.dek: 政制及內地事務局局長向《星島》表示，22項主要指標只有5項屬約束性，每年施政報告適合做一次小檢視。
body: 政制及內地事務局局長謝小華表示，香港第一份五年規劃沒有把大部分指標定得太死，以免被人理解為走向計劃經濟。
《星島》星期一早上刊登的專訪中，謝小華說，上月公布的規劃列出22項主要指標，其中只有5項屬約束性。她說，指標定得太死會被指搞計劃經濟，完全不定又會被指沒有承擔。本地生產總值涵蓋各行各業，難以準確預測，但政府仍希望經濟增長維持在合理幅度；若外圍大約做到百分之三至四，香港做不到便要解釋。
她說，政府會持續監測進度、管控風險及評估落實情況。每年施政報告是做小總結的適當時機，檢視哪些做得好、哪些要加快。大方向正確便不必大改，一個地方的發展規劃不應頻繁變動，否則市場和投資者會失去信心。
謝小華又說，澳門正探索在中期及總結評估引入第三方評估，香港暫時未有定案。市民、傳媒和專業團體已密切留意規劃，某程度上已發揮監察作用。她三月底上任後統籌的諮詢共收到超過一萬七千份意見，逾八成來自個人。
